title: QBR field readout: operational deck and escalation decision lattice
creator: Lena Ortiz
description: Produce a compact, operationally-focused QBR/readout packet tailored for field and exec audiences that emphasizes: (1) customer-facing impact of roadmap delivery, (2) decision lattice for escalation and trade-offs, and (3) contingency lanes for product & infra risks. The deliverable is a 12-16 slide deck plus a 1‑page decision appendix and an annotated action tracker for follow-ups. This ticket covers synthesis of cross-functional inputs (Eng, SRE, Sales, CSM) and the first-run stakeholder review. Scope excludes final slide styling; includes signoff path and handoff to comms for distribution.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Complete draft deck with data-driven slides for three priority initiatives (Serving runtime SLOs, Dedicated autoscale, Private deployment onboarding); 2) Decision lattice appendix with explicit asks and recommended options (retain, accelerate, deprioritize) for each initiative; 3) Risk lanes with mitigation owners and RAG status; 4) Action tracker with owners, due dates, and dependencies; 5) Stakeholder signoff from Eng lead, Head of Sales, and Head of Customer Success.
